title.en: Scaling laws and accounting: compute, data, and memory
title.zh: 缩放定律与核算：计算、数据与内存

en.a: A fixed compute budget must be allocated between parameter updates, training tokens, and memory traffic; scaling laws describe an empirical allocation, while accounting identities expose the cost terms.
en.b: The model still defines a prefix-conditioned next-token distribution. N, D, and C determine how much evidence and computation can shape that distribution, and memory accounting determines whether the computation can be executed.

zh.a: 固定的计算预算必须在参数更新、训练令牌和内存流量之间进行分配；缩放定律描述了经验性的分配方式，而核算恒等式则揭示了成本项。
zh.b: 模型仍然定义了一个前缀条件化的下一个令牌分布。N、D 和 C 决定了有多少证据和计算可以塑造该分布，而内存核算则决定了计算是否可以执行。
